seatbelt-sandboxer (public, reputation established): read the skills.sh page (skills.sh/trailofbits/skills/seatbelt-sandboxer): the skill generates minimally-permissioned, allowlist-based Seatbelt sandbox configurations that restrict a process's file and network access, triggered when a user asks to sandbox, isolate or restrict a macOS process, with supply-chain compromise named as the threat it mitigates. That is the remedy's isolation mechanism - putting credentials and network destinations physically out of reach of the process running model-written code. It performs no credential brokering or short-lived token exchange, and its declared non-applicability is Linux containers, Windows, and processes legitimately needing broad access.

not_applicable_when: Agentがcredentialを一切持たない読み取り専用task
